name: Ray-guided streaming with atomic bitfield marking
definition: A technique to track which finest-level brick cells have been visited by rays to enable selective streaming/refinement, using an atomic bitfield buffer to avoid redundant writes when multiple rays share a cell.
summary: Ray-guided streaming with atomic bitfield marking tracks visited cells via an atomic buffer to prevent redundant data transfers, differing from XBrickMap by adding dynamic visitation history to static hierarchical skipping.
